Kafta Salad
By: miansari66
Published: Monday, February 7, 2011 - 2:53am

Ingredients




1 Tomatoes chopped
2 Spring Onion chopped
1 Green Chillies chopped
1/2 Cucumber medium size chopped
6 pieces Lemon wedges quartered
1 tablespoon Olive oil
1/2 teaspoon Sumak powder

Preparation

1 Mix all ingredient together except sumuk powder in a frying pan and toss over medium flame for 1 minute. 2 Pour into serving bowl and sprinkle sumuk at top. 3 Serve with Kafta Kabab.

About


This salad is very eye appealing and mouth watering to be served with Kafta Kabab
